The dark theme can go true black for OLED screens, the accent can follow your system's colour, and KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.2.1 on every surface.

## ✨ Added

- **An OLED switch under the theme puts the dark theme on true black** for OLED and AMOLED screens, in the web interface, the desktop app, the phone app and the browser extension. It counts whenever dark shows, also when the theme follows the device, and each browser or phone keeps its own choice. With Light chosen the switch keeps its state and shakes when pressed. The desktop window's frame turns black with the page. Thanks to [@leonp5](https://github.com/leonp5), who asked for it in ArrowLoop ([#123](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/123)).
- **A wand swatch at the start of the accent row takes the system's colour:** Material You on Android 12 and newer, the accent colour of Windows, macOS or Linux in the desktop app, and the system colour in Firefox and Safari. Choosing it changes only that device, so every other client keeps the instance's accent, and a circle picked afterwards goes back to it. Where the system has no colour, the swatch isn't there. This one is also [@leonp5](https://github.com/leonp5)'s idea, from ArrowLoop ([#124](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/124)). Thank you!
- **The browser extension has a Version card** before Help and About, as the Info tile of the web interface does. Each version links to its release.

## 🎨 Design

- **KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.2.1 everywhere,** in the web interface, the desktop app, the phone app and the browser extension, and the Version card names it.
- **Text on an accent fill is near-black on Blue, Red, Purple, Orange and Pink,** where white read at only 2.3 to 3.0:1. Every ink the colour engine works out reaches 4.5:1, so a colour mixed by hand or taken from the system reads as well as the presets.
- **The lists tell more kinds of file apart by their symbol:** PDFs, office documents, spreadsheets, presentations, e-books, playlists, disk images, programs, fonts, 3D models, checksums, torrents, RAW photos and design files.
- **Notifications all have the same width,** and a button such as Undo stands under the message. A path breaks after a slash instead of in the middle of a name. On a phone the notifications span the window and the newest two show.
- **A text field shows that you are typing in it by a lighter fill** rather than a ring, in the web interface, the phone app and the extension. Menus and other fields without a caret keep the ring.
- **A switch that is off is darker in the light theme,** so it stands out from the card it sits on.
- **The colour picker works with the arrow keys,** Shift for bigger steps, and with a pen as well as a mouse or a finger. The handle shows the colour under it.
- **The buttons at the foot of a window wrap on a narrow screen** instead of squeezing their words. A button that does not fit moves to a second row.
- **The phone app and the extension use GlimStone's five text sizes and its button symbols,** and their warnings are orange. Under rainbow each selector takes its own colour while text keeps the one accent.
- **Chrome's button is green.** On the Apps page, in the phone app and in the README, Chrome takes the green of its own logo, so it no longer looks like Edge's blue button right beside it.
